headings.text: Tostado y molido 20 sachets de 5 gramos Listo en tres minutos
CaFETAL Group nació en Pitalito, Huila. Tostamos nuestro café de origen y lo guardamos en un sachet que se prepara como una infusión.
Del cafetal a tu taza, el grano nunca pierde su origen.
Cada taza pasa por AiCAFÉ, suelos vivos, el Mirador del CaFETAL, Mujeres Sembrando Vida y comercio justo.
CaFETAL Group nació en Pitalito, Huila. Tostamos nuestro café de origen y lo guardamos en un sachet que se prepara como una infusión.
Del cafetal a tu taza, el grano nunca pierde su origen.
La mata Crece en las laderas de Pitalito, entre neblina y sol de montaña.
La cosecha Cerezas maduras, una a una, cuando están rojas.
El secado Al sol, en patio, hasta que el grano está listo.
La trilla Se limpia el grano antes de tostarlo y molerlo.
La caja Veinte sachets de cinco gramos, en cinco sabores.
Cada taza pasa por AiCAFÉ, suelos vivos, el Mirador del CaFETAL, Mujeres Sembrando Vida y comercio justo.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "CaFETAL Group nació en Pitalito, Huila. …" → 4 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 552px at 17432px; 436px at 11476px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 9 different lines (46px, 66px, 275px, 356px, 1077px, 423px, 445px); the three most used hold only 53% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Tostado y molido 20 sachets de 5 gramos Listo en" (screen 1, 42% hidden); "COLOCA" (screen 11, 25% hidden); "VIERTE" (screen 12, 25% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "CAFE ´ É DE" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "PITALITO" (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "HUILA" (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 6 screens in a row: "Nuestra historia"; "Del cafetal a tu taza, el grano nunca pierde su origen."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: The h1 is 24px ("CAFE ´ É DE PITALITO HUILA").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
